create_block: create a Block module with configurable attention, MLP, layer scaling, and drop path for vision transformer layers
build_nested_tensor_block: build a NestedTensorBlock that processes lists of tensors with xFormers block-diagonal attention
run_stochastic_depth_residual: run drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth to apply stochastic depth with residual scaling to a tensor batch
test_stochastic_depth_list: test drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth_list to apply stochastic depth with residual scaling to a list of tensors
get_attention_bias_and_cat: get get_attn_bias_and_cat to compute block-diagonal attention bias and concatenate tensors for efficient grouped attention
